3.speaker: Narrator
3.text: My motorcade pulled up to the VIP entrance of the Royal Grounds in Montaklar, an unmarked blue door tucked discreetly around the corner from the main gates.

4.speaker: Narrator
4.text: Today's match was a friendly one, taking place outside the regular championship season. Its purpose was to raise awareness for polio vaccination.

5.speaker: Narrator
5.text: Normally, Real Montaklar would be the hands-down favorite to win. But FC Porte Drazon had been steadily improving since my investment in them.

6.speaker: Narrator
6.text: As usual, Real Montaklar was the hands-down favorite to win. Since my investment in them, they'd been crushing every team in their path.

17.speaker: Narrator
17.text: Still, it was between Real Montaklar and FC Porte Drazon -- the fiercest rivalry in Rizian football -- so both spirits and tensions were high.

18.speaker: Narrator
18.text: As usual, Real Montaklar was the hands-down favorite to win, although both teams had put in unusually poor performances this past season.

19.speaker: Narrator
19.text: Only Titus was accompanying me today. Mother and Pabel were presiding over a luncheon for a lesser Rumburgian dignitary in Porte Drazon. Hugo declined to attend out of solidarity for his favored team, Royal FC Valenqir.

23.speaker: Narrator
23.text: As for Vina, she'd departed for Pales a week ago. The Herald had published impressive-looking photos of her welcoming ceremony at Castle Reinhart.

24.speaker: Narrator
24.text: As for Vina, she and Manus had opted to support the cause by visiting the polio research wing of the new Romus Toras Hospital.

37.speaker: Narrator
37.text: We were welcomed at the entrance by the teams' representatives and the head of stadium security. After a round of introductions, they ushered us through a series of back passages towards the royal tribune.

38.speaker: Player_Romus
38.text: "So you're my date for the match, eh, Titus?"

39.speaker: Narrator
39.text: Titus' mouth twitched, as if unsure whether to take the remark seriously or in jest.

40.speaker: Titus Gordion
40.text: "I'll be right behind you, keeping a close watch on the stands."

41.speaker: Player_Romus
41.text: "Which team are you pulling for, Captain?"

42.speaker: Player_Romus
42.text: "Any threats I should be aware of today, Titus?"

43.speaker: Titus Gordion
43.text: "Don't worry, Your Majesty. The increase in revolutionary activity has been concerning, but we'll have the royal tribune under maximum protection."

47.speaker: Titus Gordion
47.text: "Don't worry, Your Majesty. We'll have the royal tribune under maximum protection."

48.speaker: Titus Gordion
48.text: "The only threat I'm worried about is Shanlo Zima. Real Montaklar's new star forward."

49.speaker: Narrator
49.text: Titus nearly stopped in his tracks.

50.speaker: Titus Gordion
50.text: "FC Porte Drazon, of course, Your Majesty! I used to dream about playing for them before I found my calling in the boxing ring."

51.speaker: Titus Gordion
51.text: "*When* F.C. Porte Drazon wins, it's bound to rile up the Azaros."

52.speaker: Player_Romus
52.text: "Our boys have got this. 'Loyalty, Integrity, F.C.P.D.'"

53.speaker: Player_Romus
53.text: "I'm sorry to say Real Montaklar will wipe the floor with the competition. 'The Pitch Our Battlefield, Our Feet Our Swords'."

54.speaker: Player_Romus
54.text: "As the King, I must remain impartial. I shall cheer on both teams with equal enthusiasm."

55.speaker: Player_Romus
55.text: "I confess I'm not a football fan. I'm only here by royal obligation."

59.speaker: Titus Gordion
59.text: "A difficult task. I don't envy you."

60.speaker: Titus Gordion
60.text: "It's a beautiful game, Your Majesty. Taught me everything I know about strategy and cooperation."

61.speaker: Narrator
61.text: We emerged into the daylight as the Rizian national anthem blared from the stadium speakers, announcing the King's entrance.

62.speaker: Narrator
62.text: Most of the guests in the tribune were House Azaro nobles clad in Real Montaklar's blue and yellow. I spotted Lucita front and center, next to a frail, hunched-over man in a wheelchair.

63.speaker: Narrator
63.text: It took me a moment to realize that this was her father. General Taddeus.

64.speaker: Narrator
64.text: Just as our eyes met, I was whisked away to my own seat a few rows above them.

65.speaker: Narrator
65.text: Rusty Montoro bowed hurriedly before lowering himself into the seat beside mine.

66.speaker: Player_Romus
66.text: "Are you quite sure that's your seat?"

67.speaker: Player_Romus
67.text: "May I visit the team in the locker room? I've got some inspirational words for them."

69.speaker: Titus Gordion
69.text: "Sorry, Your Majesty. Post-Friendship Day security protocol doesn't allow for it."

70.speaker: Titus Gordion
70.text: "It's a shame. Your words could have spurred FC Porte Drazon on to even greater heights."

71.speaker: Player_Romus
71.text: "I shouldn't choose sides as the king, anyway. I shall cheer on both teams equally."

72.speaker: Player_Romus
72.text: "I was referring to Real Montaklar. 'The Pitch Our Battlefield, Our Feet Our Swords'."

73.speaker: Player_Romus
73.text: "A pleasure to see you again, Mr. Montoro. What brings you here?"

74.speaker: Player_Romus
74.text: "Rusty. I've been meaning to get in touch with you."

75.speaker: Russello Montoro
75.text: "Same thing as you, Your Majesty. I'm here to watch some football."

82.speaker: Russello Montoro
82.text: "Must be, Your Majesty. Every other chair's got an Azaro in it."

83.speaker: Russello Montoro
83.text: "Have you? I couldn't be more honored."

84.speaker: Russello Montoro
84.text: "Nice day for football, isn't it, Your Majesty?"

85.speaker: Narrator
85.text: A bell rang to signal the start of ceremonies. The spotlight shone onto the center of the field, where one of Rizia's leading polio scientists made an introductory speech.

88.speaker: Player_Romus
88.text: "I wouldn't have taken you for a football fan."

89.speaker: Russello Montoro
89.text: "Are you kidding, Your Majesty? I love it!"

90.speaker: Player_Romus
90.text: "You shall speak when you're spoken to."

95.speaker: Narrator
95.text: He closed his mouth, seemingly unbothered.

96.speaker: Russello Montoro
96.text: "You just want to watch the game. I get it. So do I."

97.speaker: Player_Romus
97.text: "I was having a good day until this very moment."

98.speaker: Russello Montoro
98.text: "Hey, I'm only here to watch football. Same as you."

104.speaker: Narrator
104.text: Titus mouthed the slogan as I spoke it.

105.speaker: Narrator
105.text: As I took in the view, I noticed a red-haired figure weaving his way towards me.

106.speaker: Russello Montoro
106.text: "Let's see now... Row 5, seat 2, 3... Here we are! Best seat in the house!"

107.speaker: Narrator
107.text: Once my eyes adjusted, I saw that the stands were packed top to bottom with thousands of football fans. All of them were on their feet, applauding me.

111.speaker: Narrator
111.text: A stadium attendant rushed to bring me refreshments. The facilities here were outdated compared to the new stadium in Porte Drazon, but the historic atmosphere couldn't be beat.

112.speaker: Narrator
112.text: A stadium attendant rushed to bring me refreshments. The facilities here were a little outdated, but the historic atmosphere couldn't be beat.

120.speaker: Russello Montoro
120.text: "Thanks for taking care of that strike in Argno. Just hope it was enough to shut the commies up."

124.speaker: Russello Montoro
124.text: "You'll be happy to know that strike in Argno didn't affect our facilities one bit."

125.speaker: Russello Montoro
125.text: "Couple strategic firings, a few ringers scampering past the picket line, and boom! Back up and running."

129.speaker: Russello Montoro
129.text: "I thought we had an understanding, you and I. A couple of loudmouths in Argno made you change your mind?"

130.speaker: Russello Montoro
130.text: "The new mining regulations have been every bit as fiddly as I feared. We're practically bleeding cash."
130.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Welfare_WorkersRightsAllIndustries"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Decision_Turn06_MalenyevistWorkers_Promise"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Decision_Turn06_MalenyevistWorkers_Promise"] == true) == false)

131.speaker: Russello Montoro
131.text: "I'm guessing you've heard about their ringleader Sotelato. Fancies himself a regular Malenyev Junior."

135.speaker: Player_Romus
135.text: "He's tapping into commoners' hunger for change. But we can address that without involving him or his ideology."

139.speaker: Player_Romus
139.text: "We need a young, charismatic figure who can offer a less extreme alternative. Manus Sazon, perhaps."

140.speaker: Russello Montoro
140.text: "Just a flash in the pan. Probably some noble's kid who went to university and decided to reinvent himself."

141.speaker: Player_Romus
141.text: "His grievances are legitimate. We can't dismiss them completely."

143.speaker: Russello Montoro
143.text: "Maybe not. But the trick is to throw these folks a bone. Not the whole chicken."

148.speaker: Russello Montoro
148.text: "You're not really thinking of giving in to those strikers in Argno, are you?"
148.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Welfare_WorkersRightsAllIndustries"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Decision_Turn06_MalenyevistWorkers_Promise"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Decision_Turn06_MalenyevistWorkers_Promise"] == true)

149.speaker: Player_Romus
149.text: "It was either that, or face greater trouble down the line."

150.speaker: Player_Romus
150.text: "It's either that, or face greater trouble down the line."

151.speaker: Player_Romus
151.text: "My words were just that. Words. The strikers' movement will fizzle out before I have to deliver on my promise."

153.speaker: Player_Romus
153.text: "I underestimated the strength of the workers' movement. These people are calling out for change, and if they don't get it, there'll be riots in the streets."

154.speaker: Player_Romus
154.text: "I still want to cooperate with RRG, Mr. Montoro. You're just going to have to compromise on this one issue."

155.speaker: Russello Montoro
155.text: "Trust me, Your Majesty, you do not want to embolden these folks."

156.speaker: Russello Montoro
156.text: "I know these folks put you in a tight spot. But bending over backwards for 'em because they stopped working for a few days? Your Majesty, that's what scabs are for."

157.speaker: Player_Romus
157.text: "If your workers are happier, it'll be worth every penny in the long run."

159.speaker: Player_Romus
159.text: "And yet somehow, you're still able to donate millions towards polio research."

161.speaker: Player_Romus
161.text: "You'll get it back once those increased royalties from the MITZ start coming in."

165.speaker: Russello Montoro
165.text: "Right, yeah. We sure stuck it to Lespia."

170.speaker: Player_Romus
170.text: "Your returns from the Qalus gold mine will make up for it."

171.speaker: Russello Montoro
171.text: "Partly. I do thank you for that."

172.speaker: Russello Montoro
172.text: "They want change, throw 'em a bone. Not the whole chicken."

173.speaker: Player_Romus
173.text: "That's not how I would have handled it."

174.speaker: Player_Romus
174.text: "Well done. I knew our businesses could handle this without the Crown's intervention."

175.speaker: Player_Romus
175.text: "You couldn't have just given the strikers what they wanted?"

176.speaker: Player_Romus
176.text: "They could become a serious threat. I suspect they have aid from Morella."

180.speaker: Player_Romus
180.text: "They could become a serious threat. Especially if CSP countries get wind of their cause."

181.speaker: Player_Romus
181.text: "We retaliated with the full force of the Crown. They won't dare rise up like that again."

182.speaker: Player_Romus
182.text: "They talk a big game, but in the end, they'll scatter at the sight of a police baton."

183.speaker: Player_Romus
183.text: "Don't underestimate the strength of the worker's movement. I suspect they have aid from Morella."

187.speaker: Player_Romus
187.text: "Don't underestimate the strength of the worker's movement. They could become a real threat if the CSP decides to start aiding them."

188.speaker: Russello Montoro
188.text: "I'm not underestimating. But nor am I about to let those commies bully me into changing my business."

189.speaker: Russello Montoro
189.text: "And let the commies think their gambit worked? Heck, no."

190.speaker: Russello Montoro
190.text: "It wasn't like that for everyone. I reckon about half of Argno's companies caved to the commies in the end."

191.speaker: Russello Montoro
191.text: "These are commies we're talking about. What other way is there?"

192.speaker: Russello Montoro
192.text: "If they do start stirring up more trouble, I trust my King will nip it in the bud."

193.speaker: Russello Montoro
193.text: "Something tells me we haven't heard the last of these guys."

194.speaker: Russello Montoro
194.text: "Unless there's too many of them to overpower."

199.speaker: Russello Montoro
199.text: "Your daughter's beau. Now can you admit I was right?"

200.speaker: Player_Romus
200.text: "We need a distraction to lure the populace away from him."

201.speaker: Russello Montoro
201.text: "A royal wedding, maybe? Seems like Her Highness would be a willing participant."

205.speaker: Russello Montoro
205.text: "We make enough money, you'll be able to afford all the distractions you want."

206.speaker: Narrator
206.text: He sat back in his chair with relief.

208.speaker: Narrator
208.text: As the team formed a line, Lucita animatedly paced back and forth, nearly knocking over her father's wheelchair as she did so.

212.speaker: Russello Montoro
212.text: "As well as your level-headed thinking regarding the MITZ."
212.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Turn05_ITZVote_Nationalization"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.MITZ_ScrewedOverLespia"] == false) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.MITZ_Renegotiation_Failed"] == true) == false)

213.speaker: Russello Montoro
213.text: "On the bright side, we're set to make a good chunk of change from Qalus."
213.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Economy_QalusGoldMine_Completed"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Economy_QalusGoldMine_Project"] == true) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Welfare_WorkersRightsAllIndustries"] == false) == false)

220.speaker: Russello Montoro
220.text: "But between the regulations and our MITZ royalties drying up... things are not looking good for old RRG."

224.speaker: Russello Montoro
224.text: "But between the regulations and our shrinking gold reserves in Rizia... things are not looking good for old RRG."

225.speaker: Russello Montoro
225.text: "On the bright side, we still have our MITZ royalties to look forward to."
225.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Economy_QalusGoldMine_Completed"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Economy_QalusGoldMine_Project"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Turn05_ITZVote_Nationalization"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Welfare_WorkersRightsAllIndustries"] == false) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.MITZ_Renegotiation_Failed"] == true) == false)

226.speaker: Russello Montoro
226.text: "And we've still got our MITZ royalties to look forward to, if everything pans out."

230.speaker: Russello Montoro
230.text: "I had all kinds of ideas for how we could keep going with our cooperation."

231.speaker: Russello Montoro
231.text: "But unless you can assure me you won't give in to the Malenyevists, we might as well go back to talking about football."

235.speaker: Player_Romus
235.text: "What 'cooperation' are you talking about? I made a few decisions that were in your interests. That doesn't make us friends."

236.speaker: Russello Montoro
236.text: "No. But we could still be associates. Allies. Dare I say co-conspirators?"

238.speaker: Russello Montoro
238.text: "Hmm. You know, I would, but I just can't remember them at this very moment."

239.speaker: Player_Romus
239.text: "I'm tired of your antics, Mr. Montoro. This conversation is over."

240.speaker: Player_Romus
240.text: "I can't make any assurances, Rusty. I don't know what the future will hold."

241.speaker: Player_Romus
241.text: "I am sorry to disappoint you, but I made those protesters a promise and I do intend to follow through on it."

242.speaker: Player_Romus
242.text: "Very well. I assure you that the Crown will not make any decree interfering with the working conditions at RRG."

243.speaker: Russello Montoro
243.text: "Point is, between the regulations, our MITZ royalties drying up and our shrinking gold reserves in Rizia... things aren't looking good for old RRG."
243.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Economy_QalusGoldMine_Completed"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Economy_QalusGoldMine_Project"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Turn05_ITZVote_Nationalization"] == true) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Welfare_WorkersRightsAllIndustries"] == false) == false)

244.speaker: Russello Montoro
244.text: "But it's the workers I'm worried about. Don't want 'em picking up any more big ideas from the east."

245.speaker: Player_Romus
245.text: "Rizian Royal Gold is one of this country's oldest and proudest companies. I won't let it go under."

247.speaker: Player_Romus
247.text: "I regret to tell you that gold is about to become a part of Rizia's past. Gas is our future."

251.speaker: Player_Romus
251.text: "Was that a mosquito I heard just now, or was it the world's tiniest violin?"

255.speaker: Russello Montoro
255.text: "And I in turn thank you from the bottom of my heart. What's left of it after the triple bypass."

256.speaker: Narrator
256.text: He sat back in his chair with relief.

257.speaker: Russello Montoro
257.text: "As to the future of the Crown and Rizian Royal Gold..."

259.speaker: Russello Montoro
259.text: "My pa always told me you make your own future. 'Course, his involved a bottle of port wine and a particularly hardy highway median."

260.speaker: Russello Montoro
260.text: "Far as I remember, you made a promise to me before them. But no matter."

266.speaker: Russello Montoro
266.text: "As to the future of the Rizian royal government and RRG..."

269.speaker: Player_Romus
269.text: "An Azaro. Not that her house excuses her unwomanly behavior."

274.speaker: Russello Montoro
274.text: "I wasn't asking. I know trouble when I see it."

275.speaker: Player_Romus
275.text: "You shall not speak ill of the Rizian nobility."

276.speaker: Player_Romus
276.text: "The football pitch is the one place where a noble may carry on like a commoner."

278.speaker: Russello Montoro
278.text: "No, thanks. I know trouble when I see it."

279.speaker: Russello Montoro
279.text: "Listen, Your Majesty, I know I can be a pain to deal with, but..."

281.speaker: Russello Montoro
281.text: "As for what the royal government can do..."

282.speaker: Russello Montoro
282.text: "Wouldn't want to be on the receiving end of that."

283.speaker: Russello Montoro
283.text: "Ill? I meant it as a compliment."

285.speaker: Narrator
285.text: He swiveled in his seat to face me.

293.speaker: Russello Montoro
293.text: "Tell me, Your Majesty. How can we work together?"

294.speaker: Player_Romus
294.text: "I am planning a decree reforming the Rizian voting process. Can you help me pass it before the next House of Delegates elections?" [Remove -6 Authority Cost From Electoral Reform Decree]

298.speaker: Player_Romus
298.text: "I need your help supporting the reformist movement. Starting by assisting the Rizian People's Party election campaign."

302.speaker: Player_Romus
302.text: "I am concerned about the growing strength of the reformist movement. I want your help neutralizing it."

303.speaker: Player_Romus
303.text: "Nothing right now. But I want your word that you'll back me in the future."

308.speaker: Russello Montoro
308.text: "You want my help going *against* the reformists?"

309.speaker: Russello Montoro
309.text: "Aha. I hear you loud and clear."

313.speaker: Player_Romus
313.text: "The Rizian government has an amicable relationship with Rizian Royal Gold. I'm content to leave it at that."

314.speaker: Player_Romus
314.text: "I admire the workers' initiative. Turns out they've got more backbone than certain RPP leaders."

318.speaker: Player_Romus
318.text: "All they wanted was better conditions. Now that they've gotten them, I don't expect any more trouble."

323.speaker: Player_Romus
323.text: "Morella may try to inflame anti-monarchist sentiments after the failed MITZ nationalization bid. We're keeping a close eye on potential revolutionary activity."

324.speaker: Russello Montoro
324.text: "You've got more skin in the game than I do. I'm sure you'll nip it right in the bud."

325.speaker: Player_Romus
325.text: "What do you mean? Our eastern neighbors have some superb ideas regarding the treatment of workers."

327.speaker: Russello Montoro
327.text: "Sazon put on a good show, didn't he? Just failed to convey some of the necessary nuance."

330.speaker: Russello Montoro
330.text: "And the treatment of monarchs? You ever ask them how they feel about that?"

331.speaker: Narrator
331.text: Rusty calmly peered out at the field.

332.speaker: Russello Montoro
332.text: "Could do, Your Majesty. But it would help if I knew what you were asking me to back."

333.speaker: Player_Romus
333.text: "Yes. Do you have a problem with that?"

334.speaker: Player_Romus
334.text: "Indeed. Manus Sazon may believe I'm on his side, but I'm playing a different game entirely."

339.speaker: Player_Romus
339.text: "Don't get too excited. I intend for the nobles of this country to keep most of their privileges."

340.speaker: Russello Montoro
340.text: "Long as you give the underdogs more of a fighting chance."

341.speaker: Player_Romus
341.text: "Manus Sazon told me you could be of assistance. I hope he was right."

345.speaker: Russello Montoro
345.text: "Sazon's a bright one, isn't he? A real future Prime Minister in the making."

346.speaker: Player_Romus
346.text: "Enough gloating. Will you be able to help, or won't you?"

348.speaker: Russello Montoro
348.text: "Well, Your Majesty, I certainly am sympathetic to the reformist cause."

349.speaker: Russello Montoro
349.text: "Listen, Your Majesty... I certainly am sympathetic to the reformist cause."

350.speaker: Russello Montoro
350.text: "And if you're looking for a source of funding that can't be traced back to the Crown, look no further."

351.speaker: Narrator
351.text: He nodded towards the tribune doors, where his Arcasian bodyguard Antoine was standing with his arms folded.

352.speaker: Russello Montoro
352.text: "Plus, if it really comes down to it, I've got friends in high places."

353.speaker: Player_Romus
353.text: "I don't want Arcasia or any other ATO countries to be involved."

354.speaker: Player_Romus
354.text: "What exactly is your connection to Arcasia and ATO?"

355.speaker: Player_Romus
355.text: "Your PMC lackeys have got nothing on my Golden Guard."

356.speaker: Player_Romus
356.text: "Are you certain those 'friends' don't aim to get rid of the Rizian monarchy entirely?"

359.speaker: Russello Montoro
359.text: "RRG has entrusted Arcasia with some of our most valuable patents. In exchange, the Arcasians have taken it upon themselves to assist with our personal security. Tit for tat."

360.speaker: Russello Montoro
360.text: "Fair enough. Though if you ask me, they'd be natural allies in this."

361.speaker: Russello Montoro
361.text: "But RRG has enough heft on its own. I mean, just look at me."

362.speaker: Russello Montoro
